svg.title: Profile activity — GitHub snapshot
svg.desc: 26 calendar weeks from 2026-03-08 through 2026-09-05; snapshot cutoff 2026-09-04. GitHub profile contributions, including private activity available to the authenticated owner. Dates and counts only; not Flexbar-only activity. Counts are contributions, not just commits. Cutoff day may be incomplete; this is a saved snapshot, not a live feed. Intensity bins: 0, 1–3, 4–7, 8–15, 16+. Slashed cells are missing; outlined cells are after cutoff.

svg.title: Design interface — curve, layers and editing tools
